_comment: The Archicad versions Tapir is built for, and the GRAPHISOFT/archicad-api-devkit release of each. Read by the build checks, the release, the API coverage, the Claude jobs' DevKit download, build_all_win.bat and the docs generator. tools/update_devkits.py (run daily by .github/workflows/archicad_devkit_update.yml) appends a new Archicad version when Graphisoft publishes its DevKit.
